dedupe_keys.name: gyeongbuk multi hazard evacuation data acquisition layer

description: This repository publishes Python scripts and a generated capability catalog for assembling disaster-evacuation inputs in Gyeongbuk, South Korea. The source index covers weather and river observations, flood and landslide layers, fire and earthquake feeds, roads, population and designated shelters. Its README distinguishes five hazards with all three needed axes, detection, risk and shelter, from six partial and two blocked cases. The machine-readable catalog records that distinction for an integrating application. A modeller could use the documented scripts and source map to prepare emergency-response or hazard-exposure scenarios, then verify each provider endpoint and regional coverage. This review checked the README, file tree, integration guide and data licence, but did not run API calls or inspect data payloads. The repository explicitly states that its Apache-2.0 licence applies to code, documents and investigation catalog, while original public datasets keep their provider licences. It also says some FGIS files were acquired under an exceptional project arrangement that does not transfer to later users. This is a data acquisition layer, not an authorised evacuation plan or complete live service.
licence: Apache-2.0 for project code, documents and investigation catalog; third-party data follow provider-specific terms.
